{"@context":"https:\/\/schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"What is a Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO)?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"

An MVNO is a company that sells wireless services under its own brand without owning the underlying network infrastructure.
